words.note: 和 perhaps 很接近，但 maybe 較口語，日常對話中特別常見。
words.example: Maybe we should leave a little earlier.

exercises.original: Perhaps we should leave a little earlier to avoid the traffic.
exercises.zh: 也許我們應該早一點出發，以避開交通擠塞。

options.explanation: 日常建議語境中，maybe 和 perhaps 幾乎可直接互換，而且語氣自然。
表示「大概很可能」，比原句更有把握。
表示肯定，失去原句的不確定語氣。
表示根據某些證據「看來如此」，不是單純提出可能性。
是情態動詞結構，不能像副詞一樣直接放在句首修飾整句。

exercises.original: Perhaps I will call her later if I have time.
exercises.zh: 如果我有時間，也許稍後會打電話給她。

options.explanation: 說話者只是提出一個可能行動，maybe 很自然。
表示較大機會會做，語氣更強。
表示「據說」，不合第一身未來計劃。

exercises.original: Perhaps the café will be quieter after lunch.
exercises.zh: 也許午飯後咖啡店會安靜一點。

options.explanation: 表示對午飯後情況作不確定推測。
需要有「看來／據資料」的依據。
通常要改成 It is likely that... 或 will likely...，不能直接作相同位置替換。

words.note: 較中性，可用於日常或正式語境，常表示某件事有實際可能性，但說話者並不確定。
words.example: The delay was possibly caused by a technical fault.

exercises.original: The delay was perhaps caused by a technical fault.
exercises.zh: 延誤可能是由技術故障造成的。

options.explanation: 在被動結構中自然表示這只是其中一個可能原因。
表示有證據看來是如此，語意不同。
表示有人聲稱如此，不是單純可能性。
是形容詞，這裡需要副詞。

exercises.original: The missing file was perhaps deleted by accident.
exercises.zh: 遺失的檔案可能是意外被刪除的。

options.explanation: 只是提出一個未確認原因，possibly 精確。
表示這個原因較大機會是真的，比 perhaps 更強。

exercises.original: The figures may perhaps have been entered incorrectly.
exercises.zh: 這些數字可能被錯誤輸入了。

options.explanation: may possibly have been 是自然的正式不確定表達。
和 may 的不確定語氣衝突。
表示「看來」，需要證據背景。

words.meaning: 可以想像地；理論上可能
words.note: 表示某件事雖然未必很可能，但至少可以合理想像得到。
words.example: The change could conceivably affect thousands of users.

exercises.original: The change could perhaps affect thousands of users if the system is widely adopted.
exercises.zh: 如果這個系統被廣泛採用，這項改變理論上可能影響數以千計的使用者。
exercises.upgrade: conceivably · 可以想像地；理論上可能

options.explanation: could + 條件句表示結果在理論上可以想像，但未必很可能。
和 could 的推測語氣衝突。
不是基於表面證據的判斷。
表示較高可能性，語氣較強。

exercises.original: A prolonged outage could perhaps disrupt services across the whole region.
exercises.zh: 長時間停機理論上可能令整個地區的服務受阻。
exercises.upgrade: conceivably · 可以想像地；理論上可能

options.explanation: 這是一個合理可想像的後果，但句子沒有說它一定會發生。
表示有人聲稱，不是推測後果。
表示「看來」，不合條件性推測。

exercises.original: The discovery could perhaps change how the disease is treated in the future.
exercises.zh: 這項發現理論上可能改變未來治療這種疾病的方法。
exercises.upgrade: conceivably · 可以想像地；理論上可能

options.explanation: 表示這個影響可以合理想像，但仍屬未確定的未來可能。
不是根據已有表面證據作描述。

words.note: 常用於某個未來結果、風險、影響或好處「有可能出現」的語境。
words.example: The error could potentially delay the entire project.

exercises.original: The error could perhaps delay the entire project.
exercises.zh: 這個錯誤有可能令整個項目延誤。

options.explanation: 這裡強調錯誤可能產生一個未來後果，potentially 很自然。
是形容詞／名詞，這裡需要副詞。

exercises.original: The new treatment could perhaps reduce recovery time significantly.
exercises.zh: 新療法有可能大幅縮短康復時間。

options.explanation: 強調一個尚未完全確定、但可能出現的好處。
表示根據現有證據「看來」，語意不同。

exercises.original: A small leak could perhaps become a serious safety problem if it is ignored.
exercises.zh: 如果不處理，小型洩漏有可能變成嚴重安全問題。

options.explanation: if-clause 顯示這是一個可能發展出的風險，而不是已確定結果。

words.note: 較完整、較委婉的句式，適合正式分析、解釋原因或提出不確定判斷。
words.example: It may be that the figures were recorded incorrectly.

exercises.original: Perhaps the figures were recorded incorrectly.
exercises.zh: 或許這些數字被錯誤記錄了。
exercises.upgrade: it may be that · 或許；有可能是

options.explanation: 這是較完整、較正式的推測句式，適合分析可能原因。
表示根據現有資訊看來如此，證據意味較強。
缺少完整主語結構，不能直接取代句首 perhaps。

exercises.original: Perhaps the lower response rate was caused by the timing of the survey.
exercises.zh: 或許較低的回應率是由調查時間造成的。
exercises.upgrade: it may be that · 或許；有可能是

options.explanation: 正式分析可能原因時，這個句式自然又保留不確定性。
會暗示已有證據顯示如此。
表示較大機會是真，強於 perhaps。

exercises.original: Perhaps some users did not receive the message.
exercises.zh: 或許有些使用者沒有收到訊息。
exercises.upgrade: it may be that · 或許；有可能是

options.explanation: 表示一個尚未確認、但值得考慮的可能解釋。
表示看來如此，證據意味不同。
不能單獨作句首副詞替換 perhaps。 End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 大概很可能不等於 perhaps probably 表示說話者認為某事較大機會是真的；perhaps 的可能性通常較開放、不那麼確定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Perhaps she will come; she will probably come suggests a higher level of confidence.

falseSynonyms.zh: 肯定和 perhaps 意思不同 definitely 表示高度確定，和 perhaps 的不確定語氣相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Perhaps the meeting will move; it will definitely move is much more certain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 當然／肯定不等於或許 certainly 通常表示強烈肯定，不能用來表達真正的不確定性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He will certainly attend expresses confidence; perhaps he will attend does not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 很可能不等於所有 perhaps likely 是形容詞或副詞用法，通常表示機會較高，而且句法和 perhaps 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is likely to rain. Perhaps it will rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 看來／據說不等於 perhaps apparently 表示根據所見、所聞或現有資訊「看來如此」；perhaps 只是表示可能性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Apparently, the shop has closed means the speaker has some evidence; perhaps it has closed is more uncertain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 據說不等於 perhaps supposedly 表示根據別人的說法或一般聲稱，未必表示說話者自己判斷某事只是可能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The train is supposedly on time, but perhaps it has been delayed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞和副詞不同 possible 是形容詞；possibly 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is possible that the date will change. The date will possibly change.

falseSynonyms.zh: 副詞和動詞結構不同 maybe 是副詞「也許」；may be 是情態動詞 + be，意思是「可能是」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Maybe he is tired. He may be tired.
